name: Dormant Likeness
body:
Though the outer planes have changed you quite a bit, you maintain the likeness of your race in certain aspects.

Prerequisite: Must be taken at 1st level, Planar Bound Race

Benefit: Choose one racial trait (either base or alternate racial traits), and this racial trait is given to you without replacing the listed ability it would replace.
